# ibee_vpc_node_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a VM to a VPC subnet and refreshes its assigned address. Import as vpc_id/vm_id. Connectivity changes require replacement. Public or NAT connectivity may incur charges; the server enforces admission.

<!-- Generated by scripts/generate_docs.py; edit schema descriptions in Go. -->

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ibee_vpc_node_attachment" "web" {
  vpc_id    = "VPC_ID"
  subnet_id = "SUBNET_ID"
  vm_id     = "VM_ID"
}
```

| `reserved_public_ip_id` | `string` | Optional, Defaulted |  |
| `subnet_id` | `string` | Required |  |
| `vm_id` | `string` | Required |  |
| `vpc_id` | `string` | Required |  |
